ArtAround is multilingual: imagine what a huge job it is to create translations of content and related audio for all available languages! But ArtAround is with you: through integration with LLM OpenAI, with simple buttons you can create all the translations and all the missing audio in your content. It will take a while, but don't worry: everything happens in the background, you will receive a notification when finished! If you then want to record the audio yourself, even better, if you don't upload them yourself and don't generate them via LLM, as a last resort the Navigator uses the browser's voice synthesizer: the quality isn't the best, but you're always covered!

Un \"contenuto\" è un testo (con audio): A "content" is a text (with audio) read by the Navigator during the visit: it can talk about a specific work, an author, an artistic movement or the museum in general — it is not linked to a single visit, but can be recalled from multiple visits.
Un audio caricato a mano non ha l'eviden: Hand-loaded audio does not have word-for-word highlighting in the Navigator; one generated with OpenAI yes.
Un item è un testo (con audio abbinato): An item is a text (with matching audio) about a work or an in-depth study — you can create multiple versions for the same work, at different language levels and durations: the Navigator chooses the right one for each visitor.
Un marker è un punto sulla piantina: un': A marker is a point on the map: a work (linked to a card in Works Management) or a service/orientation (entrance, bathroom, stairs...). The type you choose determines the icon and whether it should be linked to a work.
Un'altra operazione dello stesso tipo è: Another operation of the same type is already in progress: wait for it to finish before starting another one (see notifications).
Una configurazione \"globale\" vale per: A "global" configuration applies to the entire ecosystem when a museum does not have its own; one "per museum" applies only to that museum — a museum can have more than one, reachable with different links/QRs.
Una mappa interattiva mostra dove sei, d: An interactive map shows where you are, where bathrooms, bars and exits are, and takes you straight to the next work.
Una visita è il percorso guidato che il: A visit is the guided tour that the visitor follows in the Navigator: a sequence of stages (works, insights, indications) positioned on the map. Only Published visits are visible in the Navigator/Marketplace; Drafts remain hidden until you publish them.
Una visita è una sequenza ordinata di ta: A visit is an ordered sequence of stages (works, indications, logistical notes) built by choosing from the available items - you publish it when it is ready and it can be paid or free.
Una volta create e contornate le sale, p: Once the rooms have been created and outlined, you will be able to automatically insert the markers of the works into the right rooms, then you just have to move them to the right position, but starting from inside that room! It's not a little!
usa solo lettere minuscole, numeri e tra: use only lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes
Usata dal Navigator/Marketplace per sugg: Used by the Navigator/Marketplace to suggest this visit in search results based on the visitor's declared age — it does not block anyone outside this range in any way.
Valore numerico per ordinare i piani in: Numeric value to order floors logically (e.g. -1 basement, 0 ground floor, 1 first floor) — not the position in this list.
Variante dell'icona con margini di sicur: Variant of the icon with extra margins: some Android launchers crop it into different shapes (circle, squircle...) — without a margin it risks being cut off.
Versione ad alta risoluzione della stess: High resolution version of the same icon, used by the PWA manifest for larger screenshots/splashes.
Vetrina di item e visite in vendita, cre: Showcase of items and visits for sale, created by other authors. By purchasing them the cost is deducted from your credit and you can then find them in "Purchases".
Visibile ai visitatori nel Navigator e n: Visible to visitors in the Navigator and Marketplace.
Visita pubblicata: ora è visibile ai vis: Visit published: it is now visible to visitors.
Visto che crei già contenuti o visite pe: Since you already create content or visits for a museum: did you know that you can also buy free items from other authors to reuse in your visits? Take a look at "Contents" when you have time — no need to reinvent everything yourself.
